// PROBE for tests/unit/customer-policy-page-parity.test.ts — never compiled.
// A page fragment that commits all four raw renders the guard refuses:
//   A-05 the raw policy number, A-04 the raw end-date column, A-03 premium-or-zero,
//   A-19 a status label resolved before the account language,
//   A-07 a second, raw-envelope render of the insurer.
const status = calculatePolicyStatus(policy)
const statusLabel = getStatusLabel(status)
const hasPremium = typeof policy.premiumAmount === "number" && policy.premiumAmount > 0
export function Probe() {
    return (
        <div>
            <span>{policy.policyNumber}</span>
            <p>{formatDate(policy.endDate, language)}</p>
            <p>{Number(policy.premiumAmount || 0).toLocaleString(locale, { style: "currency", currency: "EUR" })}</p>
            <span>{statusLabel}</span>
            <p>{displayInsurerName(policy.acordData.policy?.insurer || policy.insurerName)}</p>
        </div>
    )
}
